notes: Board of Park Commissioners minutes, 1937. Curated: the naming of Parkside Square, the Sun Yat-sen statue's dedication, the old Stow Lake boathouse's demolition, a Palace of Fine Arts floor.

coverage.remaining: Not placed: the Huddart bequest of 973 acres at Woodside (outside the city), the Land's End refreshment building ordered demolished, Yacht Harbor pile work (Healy-Tibbitts), Park Lodge office alterations (Frank J. Reilly, $4,779), the Richmond-Sunset sewage treatment plant, a playground site at McLaren Park.
coverage.note: Nineteen meetings held, Jan 15 to Dec 7. Dated by the opener 'was held ... on <weekday>, <date>'. Yield is falling (four placeable items). Curated list PB1937.py.
